title: Bar Juice 5000 Pear Banana 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Juice 5000 Pear Banana Nic Salt brings together two soft and subtly sweet fruits for a mellow, easy-going vape. The flavour opens with creamy Banana notes that are quickly lifted by the fresh, mellow sweetness of Pear. It’s a subtly complex combination—light and satisfying with just enough authentic fruit sweetness to keep things interesting. This 50VG/50PG e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping styles, providing clear flavour with discreet vapour production. The nicotine salt formulation ensures faster absorption with a smooth, tactile throat hit, making it ideal for use in pod systems, vape pens and beginner-friendly devices. Inspired by the flavour profiles found in disposable vapes, Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts offer the same great taste with a more environmentally responsible refillable format. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths.
